L001_neon_district.description: The heart of the city's nightlife and commerce. Towering holographic advertisements cast cyan light over rain-slicked streets. Vendors hawk synth-food, data chips, and questionable services. Temple patrols pass every twenty minutes. The air smells of ozone and cooking grease.

L011_signal_bar.full_name: The Signal - Bar and Information Hub
L011_signal_bar.description: A dimly lit bar owned by Felix. Warm amber lighting fights against the cyan glow from outside. Worn leather booths provide privacy for conversations. The jukebox plays pre-Fall music. Everyone here has secrets, and Felix knows most of them.

L026_resistance_hq.description: Deep beneath the city, accessible through hidden passages. Former subway maintenance hub converted to command center. Maps cover the walls, terminals blink with intercepted transmissions. Zero Chen's domain. Here the resistance plans its moves against the Temple.

L031_temple_spire.full_name: Temple of the Signal - Central Spire
L031_temple_spire.description: The massive ivory tower that dominates the skyline. Amber lights pulse with false warmth. Here the High Council makes decrees, Inquisitors receive orders, and the Signal broadcasts its message. Few who enter without clearance leave.

ai_hints._usage: Included in prompts for consistent behavior
general_principles: Actions should be consistent with character personality and current emotional state
NPCs remember past interactions and adjust behavior accordingly
Environmental factors (weather, time, location danger) influence available actions
Every action has potential consequences - consider witnesses, noise, faction response
The world is persistent - destroyed items stay destroyed, dead NPCs stay dead

character_behavior.when_threatened: Check faction relationship first. Temple forces attack on sight. Others may negotiate.
character_behavior.when_asked_for_info: Consider trust level, faction loyalty, potential consequences of sharing
character_behavior.when_witnessing_crime: Civilians flee or freeze. Temple calls for backup. Underground ignores or exploits.
character_behavior.when_injured: Self-preservation takes priority unless protecting someone. Seek medical help.

combat_flow.initiative_order: Determined by awareness + agility. Surprised characters act last.
combat_flow.action_economy: One major action + one minor action per turn. Movement is minor.
combat_flow.cover_system: Partial cover reduces hit chance by 30%. Full cover requires flanking.
combat_flow.injury_effects: Each wound level reduces all checks by 10%. Critical wounds may disable limbs.

social_flow.trust_building: Trust increases slowly (+0.05 per positive interaction) and drops fast (-0.2 per betrayal)
social_flow.reputation_spread: Witnesses spread information. Major actions become known city-wide within 100 ticks.
social_flow.faction_reputation: Actions against a faction affect reputation with all members
